    28	    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [CommRing A] [Algebra F A]
    29	    [Algebra.FiniteType F A] [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]

   114	    (hchi :
   115	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map L.1.val (AlgHom.id F D)).comp

   117	        (chiK.restrictScalars F).comp
   118	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map L.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)))

   123	  apply tensorProduct_map_finSubext_injective L

   126	        ((psiL.comp phiL) x) =
   127	      psiK ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map L.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)) (phiL x)) := by
   128	        exact DFunLike.congr_fun hpsi (phiL x)

   130	        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map L.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)) x)) := by
   131	      exact congrArg psiK (DFunLike.congr_fun hphi x)
   132	    _ = chiK ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map L.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)) x) := by
   133	      exact DFunLike.congr_fun hK
   134	        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map L.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)) x)

   142	theorem exists_finSubext_tensorProduct_algHom_finite
   143	    {F K : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
   144	    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
   145	    (A B : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] [∀ i, Algebra F (A i)]
   146	    [∀ i, Algebra.FiniteType F (A i)]
   147	    [∀ i, CommRing (B i)] [∀ i, Algebra F (B i)]
   148	    (phi : ∀ i, K ⊗[F] A i →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] B i) :
   149	    ∃ L : FinSubext F K, ∀ i,
   150	      ∃ phiL : L.1 ⊗[F] A i →ₐ[L.1] L.1 ⊗[F] B i,
   151	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map L.1.val (AlgHom.id F (B i))).comp
   152	            (phiL.restrictScalars F) =
   153	          ((phi i).restrictScalars F).comp
   154	            (Algebra.TensorProduct.map L.1.val (AlgHom.id F (A i))) := by
   155	  classical
   156	  letI := Fintype.ofFinite ι
   157	  choose Li phiLi hphiLi using fun i =>
   158	    exists_finSubext_tensorProduct_algHom (phi i)

   165	  have hA0 : A0.FG := by
   166	    dsimp only [A0]
